import pandas as pd

# Read source table with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_68/training_0.csv", index_col=0)

# Extract the V_GENE column by trimming the string before the first '*'
# and also remove any suffix after '-' if present (to match target examples like IGHV3)
# For example: IGHV3-30*18 -> IGHV3, IGHV3-15*01 -> IGHV3, IGHV4-30-2*01 -> IGHV4
v_gene = source1['V_CALL'].str.split('*').str[0].str.split('-').str[0]

# Create the final DataFrame with the exact target schema column name
result = pd.DataFrame({'V_GENE': v_gene})

# Write the output CSV without the index
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_68/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
